newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sirocco to list on ASX on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sirocco to list on ASX on Wednesday.

text.p: Sirocco Resources NL, formerly Kakadu Resources Ltd, said on Monday it expects to recommence trading on the Australian Stock Exchange on Wednesday after a rights issue and share placement that raised about A$3 million.

Sirocco is involved primarily in gold exploration and mining in Australia's Northern Territory, with proven and probable reserves of around 455,000 ounces of gold, Paul Marshall, Sirocco's company secretary told Reuters.
A liquidator was appointed to Kakadu in August 1995 following cost overruns during construction of a gold treatment plant and the shares were suspended from trading.
Since then a new board of directors has reached agreement with creditors and others for the recapitalisation of the company, Marshall said.
The creditors are to be paid A$500,000 and issued five million shares in Sirocco, which will be managed by an administrator, Marshall said.
A further A$500,000 of the raising was earmarked to cover expenses related to the issue, he said.
Most of the remaining funds will be used to finance further drilling and exploration, Marshall said.
There was 30.1 percent shortfall on the rights issue.
This amount, together with the share placement, was fully placed by Paul Morgan Securities Pty Ltd, the company said.
